Commentary.Commentary: We are done with this match. It turned out to be a one-sided affair with Pakistan caving in. India were clearly the superior side and now storm into the final to face Australia on 3rd February at the Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui. Both teams have won the title thrice. Who will lift the silverware for the fourth time? Do join us at 1400 local (0100 GMT) to find out. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Prithvi Shaw, India skipper, in his interview says that it was a good all-round performance. Informs that his plan when he came out to bat was to hit the loose balls away. Adds that the team played well and hopes for a similar show in the final. On being asked about his experience, he replies that playing First Class cricket with the seniors has helped him and he is proud to captain the team. Thanks the crowd for all the support and hopes for the best in the final against Australia.

Hasan Khan, Pakistan captain, in his interview says that the game was in the balance even during the halfway mark but they didn't perform well after that and things didn't go their way. He reckons that they missed too many chances in the field and their batsmen failed to perform. Adds that they picked an extra batsman but it didn't work out as per the plan. Praises his bowlers and feels that they did well throughout the tournament.

Shubman Gill receives the Man of the Match Award. He says that he rates this innings very highly, especially because it has come against Pakistan. He opines that it was not a good pitch to bat on when the spinners came on and then he reckoned that 250-260 would be a good score to defend. Thanks his dad and brother for helping him with his batting technique. On being asked about which format of the game he would prefer, Gill replies that he wants to play all the formats as it's all about adapting. Signs off by saying that he is looking forward to the final with Australia.

Pakistan will be crestfallen after this defeat. They were very clumsy in the field and that, in a way, cost them the game. To think about it, as many as 7 run out chances were not taken while a few catches also went down. In contrast, the Indian fielding was top notch. They took some scintillating catches today and showed that they were better than Pakistan in every facet of the game.

Clinical performance by India to outclass their arch-rivals! Defending a big total, their bowlers turned on the heat from the word go. They built immense pressure by bowling maidens after maidens and Pakistan eventually succumbed. Ishan Porel destroyed the top order by claiming a 4-fer, while the likes of Shivam Mavi and Kamlesh Nagarkoti kept them on the back foot. The Indian spinners then joined forces and completed the formalities.

OUT! INDIA WIN BY 203 RUNS! Smiles all around and the Indian boys are delighted. A flighted full ball on off, Iqbal kneels to slog sweep it but fails to middle his shot. Ends up mishitting it in the deep square leg region and Ishan Porel takes the catch easily. The Boys in Blue are through to their sixth final.
Shortish and on off, punched from the crease to covers.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.

OUT! Quick stumping by Harvik Desai! Roy also has a wicket to his name. He flights this one outside off and lands it full. Khan stretches well forward to play at it but misses. He loses his balance a bit too and the keeper is quick to remove the bails. They appeal, it's referred upstairs and the replays show that Khan's back leg was in the air when the stumps were broken. Dhoni will be surely proud of the speed with which that stumping was done. India are one wicket away now.

Gets well forward and brings his bat and pad together in defense.

Dances down the track and tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads,

Slower through the air, full and on off, Musa lunges and defends.

Strides forward to a full ball and defends.

Flatter and on middle, defended off the back foot.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for one.

Short and outside off, cut straight to point.

Afridi goes back to power it over the leg side but gets a top edge. It flies straight up and Shiva forward to claim the catch easily. End is nigh for Pakistan.
Afridi has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Just short! Flighted full ball on off, Afridi tries to slog sweep it across the line but gets an under edge behind. Shaw at first slip snaps it inches above the surface, it seems, but is not sure. The umpires go upstairs (soft signal out) and the replays find that it fell just in front of the skipper's hands.
Has that been taken? Prithvi Shaw is not sure. He wants to get it checked. Interestingly, the soft signal is out. Hmm...
Shaheen Afridi is in next.

OUT! The Pakistan skipper leaves the sinking boat. Another cracking catch in the field by India. Boy, they are pumped up for the occasion. Parag bowls it full and outside off, Khan advances forward and miscues his shot in the air towards mid off. Shubman Gill, the centurion, backtracks and takes a ripper. Not easy to take those running back. Everything falling in its place for India.
Helps it off his pads to the leg side but finds the fielder.

Appeal for an lbw, not given. Loopy and outside off, Saad shuffles across to flick but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. Impact outside off.

OUT! Parag strikes, good move by Shaw to introduce him. A tossed up ball landing full outside off, Nazir makes space and runs down the track for a big shot. But it comes off the toe end of the bat and balloons in the air towards long off. Shubman Gill takes a safe catch in the deep. As soon as Nazir hit the shot he took his bottom hand off the handle, indicating it slipped. Hmm...that was more of a batsman not able to transfer his weight properly into the shot. Nothing can be done now. Pakistan reeling.
Flatter and full on middle, pushed down to mid on.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. No one backing up and they pinch an overthrow.

Ishan Porel nearly takes a stunner! What an effort! This Indian outfit in the field is electric. A loopy off spinner landing full outside off, Nazir throws his bat at it and gets it away off the outside half of the bat. The ball loops in the air over cover-point and Porel comes running in from the deep. He puts in a forward dive but it falls just short.  Two runs added to the total.
Riyan Parag, the off spinner, is into the attack now. A slip in place...
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and on off, punched from the back foot to mid-wicket.
Saad Khan is in next.

OUT! Pakistan have lost half their side now and the score has not reached even 50. Singh dishes out a nice floated delivery outside off, fuller in length, Taha this time tries to loft it over covers but ends up slicing it straight into the hands of Nagarkoti at backward point. He makes no mistake and India can smell the finale ticket now.
Full and flighted outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Turns it off his pads to square leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle, skidding back into the batsman, Nazir moves back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Pitches it up and outside off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off. The run chase is going nowhere for Pakistan. The asking rate is increasing and they should at least look to rotate the strike if the boundaries are not coming.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Taha crouches and sways away from the line of fire.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Taha covers the line and shoulders arms.

Nearly drags it on! Nagarkoti steams in from around the wicket and serves a full ball outside off, Taha gets forward to drive away from his body and gets an inside edge. It nearly rolls behind to the stumps.
Goes full this time, around off, it's pushed down towards mid off.

Clips a full ball off his pads towards mid-wicket and steps out in search of a run. He is sent back and nearly slips. No harm done.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Play and a miss! Singh drags his length short and darts it around off, Taha moves back to cut but misses.
Tossed up ball outside off, Taha takes a big stride forward to cover the line and lets it through.
Flatter and on the pads, tickled through square leg for a single.
Flighted and full on middle, defended off the front foot to extra cover.

Drinks break. With four wickets down in the chase, it's needless to mention which team has the upper hand. It has been excellent pressure bowling by India, they bowled plenty of maidens to build pressure and got wickets in return. Ishan Porel has been the star so far but one cannot undermine the value of Shivam Mavi who has been unplayable. Catching from India has been terrific too and they certainly are looking the better side on the field. Pakistan have a mountain to climb. Let's see how the next phase pans out.

Taha works this towards mid on to retain strike.

The Boys in Green dropped a few sitters while the Indians have caught some tougher ones.

Outside off, Shah pokes at it from the back foot and the ball flies off the outside edge to the gully region. Shaw dives to his left to take a lovely catch. Boy, they are pumped up. Great stuff from India. It's a team game. Mavi is applying unreal pressure from one end and Porel has got a couple of wickets as a result. Top stuff.

Throws the ball high and then catches it again by coming back. Great presence of mind from the young boy!

We are back for the chase. The umpires along with the Indian fielders are out in the middle. Muhammad Zaid and Imran Shah will open for Pakistan while  Shivam Mavi will have the first new ball. One slip and a gully in place. Here we go...
